name: splunk-cheatsheet-case01
title: Splunk cheat sheet: a web server attack, search by search

slides.kicker: case 01 · boss of the soc v1
slides.title: The main Splunk searches from my web server case, on one sheet.
slides.sub: Scan, brute force, web shell, reverse shell, defacement. Built on the Boss of the SOC v1 practice dataset. Save it for your next web server alert.

slides.title: Before the first search
bullets: What data is there: `| tstats count where index=botsv1 by sourcetype`
Start every search with `index=botsv1 earliest=0` (the data is from 2016).
Field names change per log: `src_ip` (stream:http), `SourceIp` (Sysmon), `srcip` (FortiGate). Check before you filter.
Sysmon searches also need `sourcetype=XmlWinEventLog` (the add-on renames it).

slides.title: Who is hitting the website?
bullets: Loudest sources: `sourcetype=stream:http <site> | stats count by src_ip | sort - count`
As what tool: `| stats count by src_ip, http_user_agent`
What one IP hit: `sourcetype=stream:http src_ip=<ip> | stats count by http_method, uri_path`

slides.title: Which password worked?
bullets: A password sent twice: `http_method=POST | rex field=form_data "passwd=(?<password>[^&]+)" | stats count, values(src_ip) by password | where count > 1`
Status 303 is a redirect, not proof of a login. Check what the IP did next.

slides.title: What was uploaded, and who used it?
bullets: After the login: `sourcetype=stream:http src_ip=<ip> http_user_agent="*Trident*" | table _time http_method uri_path status | sort 0 _time`
Uploads with a file name: `http_method=POST part_filename=* | table _time src_ip part_filename` (it missed one upload in my case)
So also search the file name in web, firewall, IDS: `<file> sourcetype IN ("stream:http", "fgt_utm", "suricata") | sort _time`

slides.title: What ran on the server? (Sysmon)
bullets: Children of the web server: `EventCode=1 (ParentImage="*w3wp.exe" OR ParentImage="*php-cgi.exe") | stats count by ParentImage, Image`
Commands under one parent: `EventCode=1 ParentImage="*<parent>" | table _time CommandLine`
Where a program connected: `EventCode=3 Image="*<file>" | table _time DestinationIp DestinationPort`
Which account: `EventCode=1 host=<host> | stats count by User, Image`

slides.title: What did the firewall see, and when?
bullets: One connection: `sourcetype=fgt_traffic dstip=<ip> dstport=<port> | table _time srcip action sentbyte rcvdbyte duration`
FortiGate logs a connection when it ends. Start time = _time minus duration.
Bursts per minute: `| bin _time span=1m | stats count by _time`. head before sort keeps only the newest events: sort first.

slides.title: When a search finds nothing
bullets: A field search can't match an empty field. My search by src_ip missed a download that had no IPs in its event.
Before you write "not in the logs", run a plain keyword search too.

slides.title: Part 4 on Jan 13: closing the case
body: The verdict, the ticket and the handover note. The full searches, with results, are in the worklog.
